name: Dead hang
cue: Start with straight arms and a shoulder-width underhand grip.

name: Initiate pull
cue: Set your shoulders and pull your elbows down.

name: Pull upward
cue: Bring your chest toward the bar without swinging.

name: Clear the bar
cue: Lift your chin above the bar and squeeze your lats and biceps.

name: Lower under control
cue: Lower smoothly through the same path.

name: Finish the descent
cue: Keep lowering to the full dead hang before your next rep.
